name: Grant for Sex-Sorted Semen to Livestock Farmers
benefit: Under this scheme, a grant of ₹400 per dose is provided to cattle farmers for breed improvement through artificial insemination of cows and buffaloes using sex-sorted semen.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be engaged in the rearing of cows and/or buffaloes.
